channel.title: DR Congo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from DR Congo, every source cited.

item.title: Kolwezi residents protest Ruashi Mining pollution
item.description: Residents of Dilungu and Bel Air neighbourhoods cite health problems and property damage, demanding compensation.

item.title: DR Congo campaign finds 43 suspected cancer cases
item.description: Health workers screened 113 women and raised awareness among nearly 600 people in South and North Kivu.

item.title: DR Congo boxers win eight African titles
item.description: Congolese women secured all eight of their final matches at the amateur boxing championship held in Kinshasa.

item.title: DR Congo families urged to rebuild state values
item.description: Professor Dezzy Mukebayi calls for civic and moral values to be taught within families to strengthen the nation.
